_note: Copied by hand from the owner's game config on 2026-09-13 (read once, never written). DPI is not stored by the game; the owner types it in the site.
_sprintMode: Apex's default is 'toggle' (Press): one press of sprint arms it for 3 s, a running sprint stays on, and letting go of forward ends it. 'hold' sprints only while the key is held, matching the Hold option in Apex's settings.
_feel: How the camera moves with the body (docs/PLAN_MOVEMENT_CHAIN.md step B, src/main.ts). None of this moves the aim: every piece is applied to the camera's own roll, pitch offset and field of view, never to the player's yaw or pitch, so a shot fired mid-slide goes exactly where the crosshair was. All of it is scaled by the 'Sprint view shake' setting, which is already the switch for how much the view moves: Normal is all of it, Minimal is 40%, Off is none. The numbers are ours, small on purpose: Apex's camera is always a fraction behind the body and always returning, and the moment any of this is noticed on its own it is too big.
